policy.meaning: Heuristic board value, not win probability

search.rootReward: Discounted cleared-line rewards plus the final leaf board value; terminal values override the evaluator
search.terminalOrder: Completion outranks survival, which outranks blocked spawn; canonical terminal values override the evaluator
search.tieOrder: Terminal rank, value, original root order, then canonical child order
search.pruning: Global beam after each complete placement layer; retained branches only, not exhaustive search
search.cacheKeyDefinition: If enabled later: rules/observation/feature/evaluator/objective/search-policy versions and complete known board/active/preview
search.nodeUnit: Every evaluated root and child placement
search.horizon: Current piece plus at most five visible next pieces; no unknown spawn is evaluated at the horizon
